spec:
Joint synthetic ADAM producer and Dobius main bridge integration verification.
QUEUE ONLY until ROOT has checked BOTH exact independent PASS verdicts: FIXER task_4050055d577b and RESEARCH task_1ba68ddda87e. Task completion alone is not source acceptance. If V3 review requires changes, remain waiting for corrected independently reviewed freeze. ROOT will provide a live dispatch and active record before work; no worker owns this job yet. Existing authorized build, AWS deferred and historical Storage paused. Canonical repo /Users/bayou/Projects (Code)/Dobius/dobius-plus, actual ADAM /Users/bayou/dobius/projects/ADAM. Exactly two Hermes heads stay untouched. No package/install/deploy/restart/provider/credential/account/device/private-config/head/Git or live endpoint actions. Existing deps and synthetic temporary SQLite only.
After both passes, build a bounded reproducible interop harness that exercises the actual reviewed ADAM producer modules and actual reviewed Dobius main bridge/store modules together. Select the exact approved ADAM source root at dispatch (reviewed immutable candidate or ROOT-applied reviewed source), parameterize roots rather than hardcoding private paths into production modules. Own new test/runner artifacts and report only; keep accepted production source and candidate freezes unchanged. Prefer a small standalone verification runner under plans/worker-monitor-20261014 with source roots as explicit inputs; no copied toy implementation or protocol reimplementation. Production code defects go back to the existing owner with a failing reproduction, not silent edits invalidating review.
Use two distinct real temporary databases. Run actual ADAM approved-decision publication/CLI request-stdin adapter and Dobius AdamCloudIntentBridge with actual service-principal registry and CloudJobService/CloudJobStore. Inject synthetic OS peer/credentials/main crypto and transport runner only at supported trust boundaries, explicitly labeled synthetic. No real CLI IPC, account, keychain, socket or provider. Route the actual strict serialized requests emitted by the actual ADAM bridge through the actual Dobius methods, validating runtime/identity/resource/full payload and canonical fingerprint. Use actual ADAM binding consume/store logic at the main submit client seam. Keep fake human decision authority separate from service/cloud authorization.
Required composed cases: approved exact intent seals/submits one child in the same Dobius Kanban store with durable parent/intents linkage; duplicate/concurrent dispatch creates one child and no parent completion. Commit consumed binding and child BEFORE dropping response, then permanently revoke human decision, reopen ADAM database, and recover exactly the same child via authenticated read-only lookup, no second submit/consume/seal/expiry renewal/new intent. Absent lookup plus revoked/expired human authority never creates child. Revoked current service proof or cloud authority refuses lookup, including revocation while unseal is suspended, with no writes/secret leakage. Preserve distinct intent/binding IDs as wire-compatible even if normal producer chooses equality. Reject wrong runtime/project/full identity/canonical payload/malformed response; maintain stale lease/generation fences. Defaults remain disabled without configured authorities. Verify actual V3 process lifecycle false-drain behavior remains covered by native tests rather than treating interop success as lifecycle proof.
Assertions must inspect both databases and action counts, parent state and canonical job/linkage rather than only mocked calls. Record exact source hashes for both sides, meaningful failing defects if found, synthetic-vs-live limits, test commands and PASS/CHANGES_REQUIRED. Run appropriate existing focused regression suites only as necessary to confirm final source hashes and integration; no broad build or repeated unchanged checks. Write a new joint integration report and own role receipt using the task/dispatch given at execution, freeze harness/artifact hashes. Real OS authentication/enrollment/custody, production secrets, application deployment, phone/VPS and installed live bridge remain separate gates; do not claim them from this harness.
